value.rationale: The naturally arising dual of a published characteristic-two K3 quartic family has a complete uniform and nontrivial codimension-one singular geometry: an irreducible degree-12 dual, exactly six singular lines, exact hypersurface multiplicities four and eight, and fixed plane-boundary cycles. This goes beyond the established qualitative dual nonnormality and the primal node count, and provides concrete inputs for normalization/conductor and degeneration studies.
